prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original detailed chunky PIXEL ART concept artwork for Rail Link Collapse, a mobile steam-train runner through a volcanic BRICK railway tunnel. Match the visual language established in this chat: soot-black steam locomotive, circular bolted boiler face, two yellow lamps and slatted cowcatcher; warm burnt sienna brick vaults, ribbed arches, hanging black cables and wall torches, orange-red lava beneath raised masonry track beds, charcoal shadows, cyan interaction accent and green railway arrows. Crisp deliberate blocky pixel clusters, no photographic rendering, no smooth digital painting. Gameplay camera is ahead of and higher than the locomotive looking back down at its FRONT, nose pointing toward bottom of image. Train faces viewer, never rear view. Exactly THREE lanes arranged screen-left, screen-center, screen-right, each with TWO rails and sleepers, converging toward one distant vanishing point. Train in middle depth leaves bottom third clear to inspect approaching tracks. NO HUD, scores, text, letters, titles, numbers, captions or watermark. Create a WIDE THREE-PANEL environment progression concept board. Three equally sized tall 9:16 gameplay frames side by side with thin charcoal separators. SAME camera, SAME front-facing locomotive position and SAME three safe intact railway lanes in all panels. The three frames show successive districts passed during one ride. LEFT early stage: enclosed well-preserved dark brick tunnel, repeated close vault ribs, sparse lava seen through drainage arches, warm torches, few embers, relatively calm. CENTER rising danger: masonry fissures glow orange, some wall bricks have fallen away revealing molten rock, hanging cables sag, lava runs through side channels, broken upper arch revealing rough cavern overhead; keep all three tracks intact. RIGHT deepest volcanic stage: vast partially collapsed brick vault opens to volcanic cavern, brick ribs still identifiable, dramatic distant lava cascade behind the train, charred pillars, more sparks and suspended dust, hot orange rimlight; keep all three foreground tracks intact and readable. Preserve useful dark contrast on railway beds in all panels. Convey changing architecture and escalating heat rather than merely increasing brightness. Continuous visual world, no enemies, no people, no crystals. Finished cinematic game-environment concept art, clean silhouettes and readable play space.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Preserve this complete two-panel 4:3 pixel art concept board EXACTLY, with one local correction ONLY on the RIGHT panel: correct the railway turnout geometry. The front-facing train is travelling downward toward the viewer. Therefore the curved branch must START on the CENTER lane immediately BELOW the train's cowcatcher and curve toward the LOWER-LEFT repaired steel bridge lane, joining the repaired LEFT track closer to the bottom edge. Currently the branch joins the left track near its upper end and center track near the bottom, the wrong direction. Replace that curved branch with the opposite S-curve from UPPER-CENTER to LOWER-LEFT, with two parallel steel rails and wooden sleepers continuously attached to both routes. Keep the three straight lanes, green LEFT chevron sign, cyan lever, repaired left bridge, train, camera and architecture. Keep the entire LEFT panel with its left-lane lava gap unchanged. No added arrows, labels or text. This should look like a coherent actual railway switch, with no dead-ended rails or floating rail tips.

IMPORTANT the OUTPUT canvas should be LANDSCAPE, e.g. 1536 wide by 1024 high, NOT portrait. Three equal vertical panels each one third of output width (each approximately 512 wide by 1024 tall), separated by thin black lines. Expand each scene horizontally with appropriate matching side walls so all three tracks are visible with breathing room; reduce excess foreground length rather than stretching objects. Left scene intact enclosed brick tunnel and torches; middle scene cracking brick vault with glowing fissures and falling masonry; right scene collapsed vault opening into broad lava cavern with distant waterfall. Preserve one locomotive facing the viewer on center lane in each panel, same apparent scale and location, intact three-lane tracks in all panels. No captions or text or HUD. This is a comparative environment concept board.
